## prompt-3-full-ind

*Generated by Process A from [`../prompts/prompt-ind.md`](../prompts/prompt-ind.md),
adapting the `trial-protocol/sub-prompts/prompt-3-full-protocol.md` convention.
Runs in stage `trial-ind/full-ind/`.*

Author the **Stage 3 full IND** into `trial-ind/full-ind/`. The full stage
executes every bracketed `[DRAFTING INSTRUCTION]` left by `draft-ind`, replacing
each with finished IND prose, full-width tables, and the grayscale TikZ
`mermaidfig` figures (the Stage 1 catalog reproduced exactly in LaTeX).

**Quality gates (verify twice, Rule of sub-prompt 3).** For every figure confirm:
a) no text-box / arrow overlaps; b) curved arrows carry the specified `looseness`;
c) proper spacing between boxes. Each LaTeX figure must have the **same complexity
and completeness** as the Python Mermaid source. Optimize table column widths for
aesthetics from the `trial-protocol/final-protocol/publication` methods and the
amount of text per column; every table sits at the body measure (`\textwidth`)
with `>{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{..}` columns.

**Content depth.** The full IND carries the quantitative data and tables from the
author sources sufficient for Phase 1 acceptance: the 3+3 dose levels (DL1 160,
DL2 220, DL3 300 mg) with exact Clopper-Pearson precision, the eight-arm device
specification (56 DOF, 640 channels, force caps, E-stop latencies), the
five-vessel no-fly gate, the three anastomosis ring-tension bands, the
perioperative advisory sweep (29 / 3 / 0 of 32), the Dutch 2025 benchmark
comparators, the safety-reporting clocks, and the analysis populations. Target
roughly ten times the character count of
`trial-documents/final-paper/publication`.

**Files (one commit each).** `indstyle.sty`, `main.tex`, `references.bib`,
`README.md`, then the 12 `sections/sec-*.tex`. The second-to-last commit fixes
all figure and text errors; the last commit ships `full-ind-LaTeX.zip` and
`output-full-ind.md`.

**Sources used (Rule 5).** `../draft-ind/` (the executed scaffold);
`../mermaid/fig-01 .. fig-22` (figures rendered as TikZ);
`trial-protocol/final-protocol/publication/sections/*` (clinical tables and data);
`trial-documents/final-paper/publication/sections/*` (acceleration argument and
back matter); `trial-documents/inputs/llm-adoption` (authoring guidance);
`trial-ind/inputs/*` (IND template, 1571 instructions, ReGARDD guidance,
references). No `png` / `jpg`; single dashes; `§`.
